en: ...Is that a ladder? I wonder where{SAUT}it leads.

No way am I reaching that! Plus...{SAUT}I specialized in sprints.
Is that so?{PAGE}I was looking forward to seeing your{SAUT}graceful leaping...
It's impossible.{OPTION}Try jumping for us, Skull.
Right? No way anyone's reachin' it{SAUT}like that...
Hey, cut out the impossible demands!{SAUT}What am I, some insane bird man!?
Perhaps that makes for an access point{SAUT}to somewhere...
But at this point, there's no use{SAUT}speculating about it. Let's keep{SAUT}moving for now.
